before.requirement: Publish the fourth component of a four-component OBJ v line as a dedicated vertex weight.
before.reason: The before loader has no separate vertex-weight accumulator. It publishes the position vector first, then swaps the emptied vector into vertex_weights.

after.requirement: Retain the fourth component of a four-component OBJ v line in vertex_weights and publish it in the output attributes.
after.reason: The changed parser classifies a lone fourth component as a weight. LoadObj appends it to vertex_weights and transfers that vector to the output attributes. The old harness can supply the required OBJ text.

claims.reason: The dedicated vertex-weight behavior is absent before the change and reachable afterward through the same old harness.
